response.justification: The candidate is an experienced senior full-stack engineer with a strong web/backend background (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang) and solid engineering practices, but the profile does not match this embedded security networking role. There is no evidence of native-level Japanese (a hard requirement), no Linux kernel source analysis/modification, and no experience with LAN-switch firmware, MACsec, 802.1X, L2/L3 networking, or chip-vendor SDKs. C/C++ experience is limited to a brief 2014–2015 stint at National Instruments and a university project, over a decade ago. The overall seniority and general problem-solving ability are real positives, but the domain and language gaps are disqualifying rather than trainable within a reasonable ramp-up.
strengths: 15+ years of software development experience, well above the 3+ year bar
Some C/C++ background (NI LabWindows/CVI) and Linux familiarity
Strong engineering discipline: TDD, CI/CD, tooling, open-source ownership
concerns: No indication of Japanese proficiency; resume and languages list suggest none
No embedded networking or security domain experience (MACsec, 802.1X, L2/L3, switch chips)
No Linux kernel investigation or source-modification experience; C work is dated and minor

key_factors.factor: Weak C and Linux kernel depth vs. broad senior experience
